scheme_1_standard.title: Scheme-I Product Certification (Standard In-House Testing Route)
scheme_1_standard.routeSummary: Preliminary Factory Audit by BIS Technical Officers + Verification of In-House Laboratory against Scheme of Testing & Inspection (STI) + Independent Sample Testing.
scheme_1_standard.scopeSummary: Applicable to industrial goods, structural steel (IS 1786, IS 2062), cement (IS 269, IS 1489), pressure cookers (IS 2347), helmets (IS 4151), and electrical cables covered under mandatory QCOs.
scheme_1_standard.msmeBenefit: 80% fee discount for Micro-enterprises and Startups on application, processing, and minimum annual marking fees.
steps: 1. Ensure in-house test facilities conform to Scheme of Testing & Inspection (STI)
2. Submit Form-V application on Manakonline with test personnel qualifications
3. Pay application fee (₹1,000 for Micro, ₹7,000 standard)
4. BIS inspecting officer conducts factory audit & draws factory samples
5. Sample sent to BIS-recognized laboratory for independent verification
6. Grant of CM/L licence within 60-90 days upon satisfactory test report

scheme_1_simplified.title: Scheme-I Simplified Procedure for MSMEs & Startups (Fast-Track 30 Days)
scheme_1_simplified.routeSummary: Pre-testing of sample at BIS-approved or NABL-accredited independent laboratory + Document submission with satisfactory test report + Rapid grant of licence within 30 days, followed by verification audit.
scheme_1_simplified.scopeSummary: Engineered by BIS specifically to support domestic MSMEs lacking complete in-house testing equipment. Allows licence issuance on the basis of third-party NABL test reports, with deferred factory inspection.
scheme_1_simplified.msmeBenefit: 80% fee discount on application & marking fees for Micro-enterprises and Startups. Licence issued within 30 working days.
steps: 1. Draw representative production sample in presence of independent technical representative
2. Submit sample to any BIS-recognized/NABL-accredited third-party laboratory
3. Obtain satisfactory complete test report conforming to applicable Indian Standard
4. Submit online application on Manakonline along with test report and Udyam MSME certificate
5. Scrutiny of application by BIS Branch Office within 15 working days
6. Grant of CM/L Licence within 30 days; follow-up verification audit conducted within 3 months

crs.title: Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS) — Self-Declaration of Conformity
crs.routeSummary: Self-Declaration of Conformity (SDoC) based on formal test reports from BIS-recognized/NABL-accredited domestic test laboratories. No initial factory inspection required prior to grant.
crs.scopeSummary: Administered under MeitY & MNRE notifications covering electronics, IT hardware (laptops, mobile phones, tablets), solar PV inverters, and battery storage products.
crs.msmeBenefit: 80% concession on application and processing fees for DPIIT-recognized Startups and Micro/Small Enterprises with valid Udyam registration.
steps: 1. Register product profile on crsbis.in
2. Submit sample to BIS-recognized lab for testing against safety standard (e.g. IS 13252)
3. Upload test report directly from lab portal within 90 days of issuance
4. Submit Affidavit-cum-Undertaking of Self-Declaration of Conformity
5. Instant electronic grant of Registration Number upon fee clearance

hallmarking.title: Mandatory Hallmarking Scheme — 6-Digit Alphanumeric HUID
hallmarking.routeSummary: One-Time Jeweller Registration with BIS + Assaying & Laser Engraving at BIS-Recognized Assaying & Hallmarking Centres (AHC).
hallmarking.scopeSummary: Mandatory purity certification for 14k, 18k, 20k, 22k, 23k, and 24k gold jewellery and artefacts under IS 1417. Each article is laser-inscribed with a unique HUID verifiable via the BIS Care App.
hallmarking.msmeBenefit: Zero registration fee for micro artisans and small jewellers with an annual turnover of under ₹40 Lakhs.
steps: 1. Apply for one-time online registration on Manakonline with GST & Aadhaar/PAN
2. Instant registration certificate issued online without manual inspection
3. Submit manufactured gold jewellery lot to nearest recognized AHC with lot delivery memo
4. AHC performs XRF screening, Fire Assay quantitative purity test (IS 1418)
5. Laser engraving of BIS logo, purity grade (e.g. 22K916), and unique 6-digit HUID code

fmcs.title: Foreign Manufacturers Certification Scheme (FMCS) — ISI Mark for Importers
fmcs.routeSummary: Nominated Authorized Indian Representative (AIR) + Mandatory BIS Factory Audit Abroad + Independent Sample Testing in BIS-Recognized Labs in India.
fmcs.scopeSummary: Mandatory for foreign manufacturing units exporting goods covered under Quality Control Orders (QCOs) to India. Factory premises outside India are audited by BIS inspecting officers before the Standard Mark licence is granted.
fmcs.msmeBenefit: Foreign manufacturers do not qualify for domestic MSME concessions, but may utilize SAARC bilateral concessions where applicable.
steps: 1. Nominate Authorized Indian Representative (AIR) residing in India
2. Submit Form-VI application on Manakonline along with factory layout and testing capabilities
3. Remit inspection charges and travel costs for two BIS technical officers
4. BIS officers conduct comprehensive on-site factory audit abroad and seal sample lots
5. Sealed samples shipped to India and tested in BIS Central Laboratory
6. Grant of FMCS licence upon satisfactory compliance and submission of Performance Bank Guarantee
